title: 黑默丁格·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 巨大的金黄头发衬着宽阔白胡须，圆形护目镜保留发明家形象。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Heimerdinger is a small adult yordle inventor with an enormous golden hair mass, broad white moustache, round goggles, compact limbs, and a blue scientist's coat. Preserve his canonical yordle proportions without making the head even larger or adding infant features. Fully covering work clothes and boots conceal his body, while a compact turret-like invention remains inactive beside a closed equipment case.
art_direction.scene: A broad full-body study, weight settled naturally on the feet or canonical support, expansive silhouette and an economical pale environment cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: golden hair, blue coat, white moustache, brass light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
